name: re0-memo
description: Turn a finished, failed, or disappointing work cycle into portable lessons, anti-patterns, quality gates, and next-cycle vocabulary, and measure how far the work stands from its objective. Use after a build, QA pass, demo, user complaint or correction, a request the user had to repeat, a user asking why something was not done, a lesson whose own fix caused a new failure, or an abandoned attempt, and always before a restart from v0, when the useful output is what the next pass must learn rather than the code itself.
